name: Nessie
long_description:
Knowledge work is being restructured by AI. Strategy happens in Claude. Research happens in ChatGPT. Building happens in Claude Code and Codex. Meetings get recorded, notes get written, agents run for hours and leave behind traces nobody reads. The people defining the next decade of work are already thinking with AI every day. But none of that thinking compounds. Every session starts from zero. The reasoning behind decisions, the context behind strategies, the evolution of ideas across hundreds of conversations - all of it evaporates.

Nessie is the infrastructure that makes it permanent. We auto-sync AI conversations and agent traces across every major provider - ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes, and more - alongside meetings, notes, and email from tools like Granola, Read AI, Plaud, and Obsidian. Everything a team produces with AI flows into one place and compounds over time.

Nessie turns that raw, heterogeneous data into an ontology: the live state of a company. Not a static schema but a continuously updated record of what the company knows, what it has decided, who owns what, and how its thinking has evolved, kept current as new work flows in. It is queryable from any agent through our CLI, MCP connector, and plugins, shareable across a team with real permissions, and deployable on-prem for organizations that need it.

Then the loop closes. Once a company’s state is legible to its agents, every agent run becomes training signal: which skills worked, which failed, which workflows keep repeating. Nessie feeds that signal back as reviewable improvements to the skills, prompts, and processes the team runs on. This is what makes a company recursive: its agents get better from its own history, the people working with them get better too, and the compounding never stops.

Where we are going: the AI-native organization runs thousands of agents that are powerful but amnesiac. Nessie is the layer that gives them, and the humans steering them, a shared memory. Science has journals, law has case law, software has git; AI-native knowledge work has had nothing. We are building it.

Founded by two Yale CS grads and former Amazon engineers, now a team of three in San Francisco. Backed by BoxGroup, Pioneer Fund, Y Combinator, Precursor, and more.

https://nessielabs.com

launches.title: Nessie: Perplexity for Your Mind
launches.tagline: Turn your AI chats into searchable memory
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95270&key=user_uploads/854295/e88fb9f4-8055-4721-94d1-6959e0d83509)

Hey everyone! We're [Anna](https://www.linkedin.com/in/anna-zhang-y/) and [Tiger](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tiger-wang-6a9b06189/) – co-founders of [Nessie](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/nessie).

**TLDR**: Nessie turns your scattered AI conversations into a personal knowledge base where you can search, ask questions, and surface new insights.

Many of us now think through AI conversations. Our most creative moments and deepest explorations happen in conversations with AI. Nessie is Perplexity for your mind, giving every AI conversation a permanent memory.

# **The Problem**

Your best ideas are scattered.

Brilliant insights are buried in endless AI chat histories, impossible to find or build upon. Trying to connect an idea from last Tuesday’s chat with a note from today is a nightmare of copying, pasting, and losing context.

Your best ideas deserve to compound.

# **The Solution: A Home for Your Ideas**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FPSfW_0jFr4

Nessie gives your ideas a home—a single, fluid space where your notes and AI conversations live together. It’s a thinking partner that effortlessly captures your insights, building a single, perfect memory of your ideas.

This lets you:

1. **Build your personal knowledge base, effortlessly**.

   Import your entire ChatGPT history, or capture individual conversations that you don’t want to lose. Nessie automatically distills your conversations into structured notes, organized around topics you care about. Your existing ideas become a structured, searchable knowledge base without you lifting a finger.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95270&key=user_uploads/2910312/ac6fef3a-848f-45c9-8b46-667661498cfd)

2. **Instantly find any idea**.

   Search across your entire knowledge base and unearth your most brilliant ideas in seconds. Never lose a thought to a messy chat history again.
3. **Compound your best thinking**.

   Your knowledge base becomes a thinking partner. You can chat with a specific concept, a folder of notes, or your entire knowledge base to connect ideas and create new insights.
4. **Own your mind**.

   We believe agency over your own thinking is critical, especially in the age of AI. Nessie gives you transparent control over your memory. Your knowledge is built from visible, editable notes that you can shape and delete at will. Everything is stored locally and privately on your device—no one can see it but you.

# **Who This Is For**

Nessie is built for AI-native thinkers: the researchers, founders, VCs, and writers who are already using AI as a partner to develop and challenge their ideas. If you live in ChatGPT and feel its limitations every day, we built Nessie for you.

# **Our Vision**

We are building your personal context layer for the AI age. Our vision is a future where your thinking compounds effortlessly, where no idea is ever lost, and your own knowledge becomes your most powerful tool.

# **About Us**

We built Nessie for ourselves.

We met at Yale and bonded over our shared obsession with using AI to push the limits of our own thinking. We quickly hit a wall. Anna had several Gemini chats that crossed the 1M token context window—a massive limit for any major model today. The brilliant insights from those conversations are now effectively lost.

We felt constrained by tools that weren't built for the way we think, so we built the solution we needed.

We use Nessie every single day.

# **Our Ask**

1. **Try Nessie and build your AI second brain.** We are obsessed with feedback from fellow AI power users and would be honored to hear your honest thoughts.
2. **Follow our journey.** We'll be sharing updates, behind-the-scenes, and our learnings as we build in public.
   * [**X/Twitter**](https://x.com/NessieLabs)
   * [**LinkedIn**](https://www.linkedin.com/company/nessie-labs)
   * [**Discord**](https://discord.gg/6DkXCpVu6K)
3. **Share with a friend.** If you know another founder, researcher, or writer who lives in their AI chats and is constantly losing great ideas, we'd love for you to share Nessie with them.

**Download the Nessie Mac app at[ https://nessielabs.com/](https://nessielabs.com/)**

**Contact us at [founders@nessielabs.com](https://mailto:founders@nessielabs.com)**
